notes: The italic 'as' (t011) is added: no comparative morpheme stands in the Hebrew (rules 7, 30).
'shalt cause it to pass' — 'it' is added because הַעֲבַרְתָּ carries no object suffix (rule 44); the hiphil's unit is discontinuous around it and heads on 'pass'.
The final suffix of חִלַּקְתָּם takes the lexical expression 'the hair' naming its referent (rule 18), corroborated by the marginal note 'Hebrew divide them.'
Both dative לְ of 'take thee' go unrepresented with the suffix taking the pronoun (rule 40); the third לְ is written 'unto' and aligns normally.
